title: Fiend
body: A behavior-tracking app for noticing patterns through individual logs, stats, and weekly reports.
detail: Fiend explores how a direct, distinctive interface can make everyday patterns easier to see. It connects a clear product idea with a usable digital experience.

sections.label: THE IDEA
sections.copy: Give people a way to record everyday behavior and look back at the patterns that emerge.

sections.label: THE PROJECT
sections.copy: An app organized around individual logs, statistics, and weekly reports, with a distinctive visual identity.

sections.label: WHAT IT SHOWS
sections.copy: Connecting product structure, interface design, and brand personality in one experience.
